name: HYDT
fix_description: In initialMint, DataFetcher.quote reads PancakeSwap WBNB/USDT pair spot price to determine how many HYDT to mint. Attacker manipulates pair reserves via flash loan to inflate the quote. Fix: use Chainlink BNB/USD price feed instead of AMM spot price.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a flash-loan-driven price manipulation exploit against protocol-specific mint logic, requiring understanding that MintV2 relies on the WBNB-USDT pair price during initialMint(). The PoC is still fairly short and linear, but it involves multiple swaps across V2/V3, a flash callback, and coordinated repayment rather than a trivial single-step bug.
